definitions: A graphical user interface element, often resembling a funnel or a set of sliders, that, when clicked or activated, allows a user to refine or narrow down a displayed list of items, data, or content based on specific criteria.
A visual symbol used in software applications or websites to represent the function of filtering information or content.
examples: Click the filter icon to sort the emails.
The filter icon is located at the top right of the table.
She tapped the filter icon to see only unread messages.
